visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-width rotating promotional banners at the top of the page
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-bleed image banner slides (5 on source) with mostly baked-in text; one slide can overlay text and a CTA. Bottom control bar with prev arrow, dot pagination and next arrow.

contentPattern.structure: cell 1 = banner image (mandatory; may be wrapped in a link for image-only slides); cell 2 (optional) = overlay text: heading, description, CTA link
contentPattern.description: Interactive rotating component with arrows and dots; each slide is image plus optional text/CTA.

usage: Hero-position promo rotator with two or more image banners. A single row renders a static banner with no controls.
reuseGuidance: Use for full-width image banners whose text is mostly part of the artwork. For winner spotlights use carousel-winners.
